address: 423-425 Vachira Prakarn Road, Makham Yong, Mueang Chon Buri, Chon Buri, 20000, Thailand
bio: In these recipes passed down over nine decades, light seasoning allows the natural sweetness of fish, shrimp, roe and other seafood to shine. Served with two punchy dipping sauces, the standout dry-style seafood rice porridge and stir-fried seafood with egg are worth ordering.
